sentences.en: Rock and roll was a creation of the young generation.
sentences.zh: 摇滚乐是由年轻一代创造的。

sentences.en: Investors must distinguish between genuine value creation and wishful thinking.
sentences.zh: 投资者必须区分真正的价值创造和盲目乐观。

sentences.en: The new law facilitates the creation of many new jobs.
sentences.zh: 新法律促进了许多新职位的产生。
